snippet.description:
A mysterious 2cm object found in Ancient Egypt wall carving

The tiny object has an unusual shape and detailed design, making it easy to wonder whether it was a symbolic artifact, a ceremonial object, or something with a practical purpose. Ancient Egyptian carvings often preserved fascinating details about their beliefs, rituals, daily life, and technology.

Was this simply an artistic symbol, or could it represent something we still don’t fully understand?

Watch closely and decide what you think this mysterious carving depicts.
